title: Sprint 186 — Component Breadth Wave 2: the remaining 23 components, every saved design reachable, one component union
focus: Derek confirmed 2026-09-06: make every saved design in the store generate and pass the consumer gates in both frameworks by porting the remaining 23 components and folding the eight ported components into the root, with the closeout cut to what already exists. Measured at 5aa53b3a (Sprint 185 review head) by the reachability census: five schemas remain unreachable, blocked by exactly 23 components, all of which already have executing HTML renderers in packages/mcp-server/src/render/component-map.ts and sit in the 109-row baseline as recipe rows — test-tagged-schema (ClassificationPanel, FilterPanel, PriceSummary), user-detail-showcase (AddressCollectionPanel, MembershipPanel, PreferencePanel, TagManager), user-list-showcase (AddressSummaryBadge, MessageStatusBadge, PreferenceSummaryBadge, RoleBadgeList, TagPills), user-timeline-showcase (AddressValidationTimeline, AuditEvent, MembershipAuditTimeline, MessageEventTimeline, PreferenceTimeline), user-form-showcase (AddressEditor, PreferenceEditor, RoleAssignmentForm, StatusSelector, TagInput, TemplatePicker). Five missions, one per schema, smallest cluster first and the interactive form last; each mission's gate is its own schema's two live cells passing the applicable packed-consumer gates from live code.generate, using the Sprint 185 pattern and scripts as they are (contracts + shared scenarios + prop-value contracts + token-driven styles + React and Vue root exports + readiness rows + the parameterized live harness). Mission six folds PORTED_COMPONENT_IDS into NUCLEUS_COMPONENT_IDS (root export additive, /ported subpaths kept as aliases this sprint) and closes out with the s185 tooling unchanged: baseline surface cells from readiness evidence, one sprint-wide advertised diff, one reconnect to aquex-mcp and forge-demos, one four-suite capture at the frozen head. Exit gate: 16 of 16 saved schemas generate green in React and Vue and every applicable consumer gate passes from live generation; governed components 27 -> 50 in one union. Pace rule (Derek 2026-09-06): appreciable progress every sprint, not a little work and a lot of measuring — no per-mission four-suite captures, no new closeout apparatus, no critic workflow; the census is the grounding. Not risky code: the same evidence bar per component as Wave 1 (typecheck, package tests, packed proof, cross-framework parity), just no ceremony around it. Build fresh from cmos/planning/forge-s186-component-breadth-wave-2-decision-memo.md in the prepared worktree ~/.codex/worktrees/s186/OODS-Forge (branch codex/sprint-186-component-breadth-wave-2 from 5aa53b3a); the builder does not self-certify; the independent review session closes the sprint when it certifies.
